title: Winey Crispy Turkish Tofu Manti
description: A plant-based Turkish dish featuring crispy tofu manti filled with a winey tomato puree, served as a solo dinner option. This recipe combines the flavors of Turkey with a modern twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the crumbled tofu, tomato puree, red wine, namul, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add the olive oil to the flour mixture, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle, then place a tablespoon of the tofu mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Place the manti on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and brush the tops with a little olive oil.
Bake the manti for 20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
